nodes.label: Player accounts and host identity verification
nodes.norm_label: player accounts and host identity verification
nodes.rationale: Login goes via bagaboo-api (Cloudflare Worker + D1). Host requires server proof for staff nicks (RESERVED_NICKS), ranks computed only from verified conn.vNick; never trust client-reported profile.name. Guests verify host via hostAuth/hostProof (/vouch) and leave room on invalid proof.
